prompt: We handle prototype vehicle testing for OEMs. Which labels and assessment level do we need going into 2027?
assertions: Explains the ISA2027 PTS structure: Prototype Protection Basic (assessed at AL2) vs Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), with Facilities including Basic's scope
Maps the need: physical test facilities/vehicles imply the Facilities label at AL3 (on-site assessment)
Describes the restructured prototype module content: two domains (organizational; physical & environmental) incl. new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return-of-vehicle controls
Handles the transition: ISA-6-era prototype labels remain valid; new orders from 2027 use the PTS structure
Covers practical preparation: facility security evidence, camera/visitor regimes, lifecycle tracking of parts, disposal procedures
